name: Linen
desc: Linen behind, bright cells in front, a bar top and bottom.
_note: Ported from the ios6 design mockup: dark linen behind, bright cells
in front, a bar at the top and a bar at the bottom. It selects `grid`,
which is the layout that puts the library in a field of tiles and the
settings in a centred grouped table -- the two shapes this era is actually
made of. Helvetica Neue is not on the console, so the chain ends at Segoe UI.
The accent is a mid green rather than the mockup's dark --detail, because
the same token lands on a near-white cell AND on the linen.
